newsitem.title: USA: FCC reviewing Media General rates.
newsitem.headline: FCC reviewing Media General rates.

text.p: The Federal Communications Commission is currently reviewing somes of the rates Media General Inc charges its cable television subscribers, the company said Tuesday in a regulatory filing.
In a quarterly filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Media General said it believes it has complied with all provisions of the 1992 Cable Act, including its rate setting provisions.

However, since Media General's rates for regulated services are now subject to review, it could be subject to a refund liability if its rates were successfully challenged, the company said in the filing.
Media General, based in Richmond, Va., publishes daily and Sunday newspapers and operates network affiliated television stations and cable television franchises.
